correctness.rationale: For even s, the incidence Gram matrices are J_(s^2) and (J_(s+1)+I) tensor J_s, of ranks 1 and s. The even column sum kills J_(s^2)B, giving A^3=0. Thus ranks 2rho and s+1 of A and A^2 give exactly the three zero-primary multiplicities. For odd s the Gram matrix on points is I+J and its sole kernel direction is not killed by B^T, so rho=s^2. The zero-sum point space paired by B^T with its image gives s^2-1 copies of J_2(1). A concrete length-three zero chain starts at the indicator of one parallel class of lines, maps to the all-ones point vector, then to the all-ones line vector, then to zero. The line kernel of B has dimension s; after its all-ones direction in that chain, the remaining s-1 directions are singletons. This independently accounts for the full adjacency dimension. A zero Jordan block of length j gives one wave block of length 2j because the wave block has characteristic polynomial (X+1)^(2j) and one fixed direction. For J_2(1), h(T)=(I+diag(A,A))T, h=X^2+X+1, has square zero and rank two, including after scalar extension; it gives h^2. The gcd with X^t-1 gives the displayed time census, cyclic generators attain the maximum period in each required primary part, and Möbius inversion gives orbit counts. One fixed wave state satisfies u=v and Au=0, proving rank recovery without any assumption of Desarguesian coordinates. Replay using RESULT.md Steps 1–5. Inspected the scripts and four saved examples, not running the scripts; the examples agree with the formulas and the adjacency script shares construction/elimination code with the wave script. No experimental universality is inferred.
